East & West Village · Manhattan

PRYZM

PRYZM is at 15 Avenue B in Alphabet City, the east end of the East Village, with about 500 products from 62 brands. It is the clearest smoker's shop in the Village: nearly half the menu is pre-rolls (246 listings) and another 115 are flower, while vapes (52) and edibles (66) are small sections. It also carries 22 concentrates.

Dank By Definition (37) and Zips (36) are the deepest brands, both New York growers known for flower and pre-rolls, with Anthem, Jetpacks, PICC and Camino behind them. The entry price is $5 for 1906 drop pouches in Chill, Bliss and Boost. If you want vapes or a wide edible selection nearby, Gotham Bowery and The Flowery East Village are a few blocks west; if you want the most pre-rolls and flower in the Village, PRYZM is the stop.

PRYZM FAQ
Is PRYZM the best Village dispensary for flower?

In our data, yes. Its 115 flower listings and 246 pre-rolls are the most in the East or West Village, and the growers it stocks, Dank By Definition, Zips, Anthem and Jetpacks, are all flower and pre-roll specialists.

Does PRYZM have many vapes?

No, vapes are a small section at about 52 listings. The shop is built for flower and pre-rolls. For vapes in the Village, The Flowery East Village and Gotham Bowery each carry over 100.

How much flower can I buy at once?

New York allows adults to possess up to three ounces of flower and 24 grams of concentrate. Dispensaries sell flower in grams, eighths (3.5 g), quarters, halves and ounces; prices on Sensei show the lowest per-product price.
